description: Run a new, rate-limited TLS 1.3 scan of a public host (default port 443) to observe whether it negotiates hybrid post-quantum key exchange (X25519MLKEM768) and issue a signed Ed25519 JWS receipt (v1, policy qa-pqc-transport 1.0) verifiable offline via /.well-known/jwks.json. Use when you need a fresh measurement; use get_tls_evidence first if stored evidence is sufficient. Starts an external connection and stores a publicly accessible result. Does not judge application safety.

discovered_manifest.description: Optional discovery manifest path observed on the target host.

domain.description: Backward-compatible alias for host when scanning port 443.

endpoint_type.description: Optional endpoint classification recorded in the signed receipt metadata (e.g. mcp_remote, a2a, https).

host.description: Public hostname or IP address to probe for TLS 1.3 and X25519MLKEM768 key exchange, for example mcp.example.com.

name: scan_tls
title: Measure TLS and post-quantum key exchange
